conclusion: GPU.0 FP32 passes frozen-input correctness but fails the required 30-minute stability gate in both monolithic and isolated-worker architectures. It is not admitted as an L1 Phase 3 deployment backend.
scope_boundary: This closure does not claim that the OpenVINO GPU plugin or Intel driver is the proven root cause.
Pre-hang latency samples are diagnostic only and are not qualified deployment benchmark results.
RTX GPU.1 remains excluded from Intel pre-deployment evidence.
CPU FP32 remains the only backend that passed the Phase 3 correctness and 30-minute stability gates.
next_action: Do not run Round 3. Proceed only to Phase 3 final evidence synthesis and human acceptance; do not start Phase 4.
